name: fill_range
title: Fill Range
description: Writes a repeated byte value or multi-byte pattern over [address, address+size) in the currently selected data source. The provider must be writable (in-memory providers, file providers that are not read-only). Streams in 1 MiB chunks to avoid huge allocations; the pattern is tiled across each chunk. [M] mutates the provider. This is a destructive operation; prefer fill_range to be gated by a confirmation step in the agent's workflow.

address.description: Start address of the range to fill

value.description: Single byte value to write (0..255). Use 'value' for a single-byte fill or 'pattern' for a multi-byte repeating pattern. If both are provided, 'pattern' wins.

pattern.description: Multi-byte pattern to repeat. Raw bytes; not parsed as hex. e.g. 'DEADBEEF' is the 8-byte pattern [0xDE, 0xAD, 0xBE, 0xEF, ...]. (Use 'value' for single-byte fills.)
Raw pattern bytes as a string
